reviews_captured_by_me.text: I contracted with Kinley Remodeling to build a portico over our front entrance. While it took a little longer than anticipated, it was worth the wait! Love it! It is exactly what I wanted. Will was great to work with and communication with him was excellent. He sought my input throughout the process. His crew was very professional. I will definitely call Will for future projects.

I couldn’t be happier with the shower floor replacement done by Kinley Remodeling. Our old tile was leaking, but Kinley Remodeling transformed it into a highlight of our bathroom.
The craftsmanship is top-notch. They were incredibly professional, showed up on time every day, and kept the workspace spotless. It’s rare to find someone who pays this much attention to the small details and ensures everything is 100% waterproof. If you need tile or remodeling done right, I highly recommend them!

Highly recommend for quality work. Wil was willing to step in and finish our kitchen remodel after an unexpected contractor crisis.  Wil and crew were professional, timely and sensitive to our situation.  His tile work was fantastic. We will definitely call Wil for any future  home projects.Thanks again Wil.
